selectionMethod: Parse matrix/environment annotations and details.inventory-scope.config; never classify by the generic title.

findings.observation: 320px originals clip compatibility subtle and the long fit action at the right viewport edge. Original native overflow assertion failed.
findings.correctionScope: Root reports host Demo minmax track correction. These old screenshots are retained, unapproved and not evidence for the later correction.

findings.observation: basic.demo inventory shows a pill while the same candidate public s/default matrix shows the documented desktop default radius.
findings.cause: Exact direct DemoFrame copies only meta.args; shape is absent, not auto-filled with the optional enum first value. Owner-source shared CSS declares defaultShapeStyle first and equal-specificity baseStyle height/2 later; public matrix CSS has the opposite order.
findings.minimalRecommendation: Remove the competing unconditional baseStyle radius and retain the mutually exclusive shape classes as the source of truth; validate default/explicit shapes/selected/pressed across owner and public entry. Do not mask with Theme changes.

boundaryReferenceAnalysis.observation: Light outlined/dashed have a fine light-gray boundary; dark outlined/dashed are weak on the dark surface. Focus rings are separately clear in the reviewed focus images.
boundaryReferenceAnalysis.pinnedReference: Outline combines a border, background surface and small shadow. Its dark variant uses input-derived border and translucent input surface. Light border/input use neutral OKLCh .922; dark border/input are white at 10%/15%. There is no dashed button variant in this fixed source.
boundaryReferenceAnalysis.candidateMapping: L3 outlined uses color.border.subtle; compatibility dashed uses color.border.default. Candidate-matching shadcn L2 maps these to neutral200 in light and neutral800 in dark; navigation.button.outlined-background maps the current content surface.
boundaryReferenceAnalysis.difference: The solid dark neutral role and content surface do not reproduce the reference translucent input layer pixel for pixel. Dashed is an explicit compatibility extension; its boundary is not an upstream dashed implementation defect.
boundaryReferenceAnalysis.conclusion: Record the weak neutral boundary and mapping difference. No global color edit or overall WCAG conclusion is justified by static impression; exact computed contrast, required cues and component-specific semantics require separate evidence.

provenanceLimitation: Historical image bytes, complete stable worker records and browser bindings checked. Exact stopped-container bundle bytes copied and hash-matched for the shape investigation; no container restart or live browser/DOM reproduction. Current host Demo correction is not substituted for historical bytes.
